entries.headline: Coded USAF traffic and transport activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that about half the expected number of coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts had been heard that day and that six large military transport aircraft were airborne.

entries.headline: Boeing E-6 Mercury AFFA30 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a Boeing E-6 Mercury with no callsign and hex code AFFA30. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Russian satellite shadowing report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a TWZ report that a Russian satellite was shadowing a specific radar-imaging satellite. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Boeing E-6B Mercury IRON23 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing E-6B Mercury IRON23, registration 164407 and hex code AE0419. The sighting was credited to reagan0965 and the photo to Paul Brito via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Jerusalem Post Sweida offensive report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Jerusalem Post report citing an official who said Syria feared an imminent Israeli-backed Druze offensive in Sweida. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: US military aircraft and 23 coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. military aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including bombers, spy planes and transport jets, and said 23 coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts had been detected that day.

entries.headline: Pakistan army chief Tehran visit report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report, citing Tasnim, that Pakistan’s army chief Asim Munir would arrive in Tehran the following day, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: Suspilne Kyiv TCC shooting report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that a man opened fire inside a TCC building in Kyiv’s Pechersk district, citing police, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: US military transports, spy plane and surveillance drone reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. military transport aircraft, a spy plane and a surveillance drone airborne over the continental United States, and described activity as about normal.

entries.headline: USAF E-4B sighting west of Kansas City reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force Boeing 747 E-4B, hex code ADFEB5, west of Kansas City. The sighting was credited to timharkness9152 and the photo to Chris Lofting via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: IAI Heron I Shoval sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Israel Defence Forces IAI Heron I Shoval, callsign 724, registration 4X-UMB and hex code 738700, flying a surveillance pattern between Netanya and Haifa, Israel. The sighting was credited to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: USAF transports, surveillance drone and coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and North Sea, together with a surveillance drone, and said 23 coded radio broadcasts had been heard that day.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: NetJets Citation Latitude arrival at KHND shown
entries.summary: SkyGlass showed NetJets Citation Latitude N910QS arriving from Denver Centennial and parking on the ramp at KHND, with ramp movements marked across the sequence.

entries.headline: BACE ramp boards launched for four Las Vegas fields
entries.summary: SkyGlass announced live ramp boards for KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU during BACE show week.

entries.headline: N200SG field view and airframe brief shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a field view and an Airframe Intelligence Brief for Falcon 50 N200SG.

entries.headline: Falcon 50 overrun and Las Vegas runway closures reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Falcon 50 N200SG rejected takeoff on runway 01L at Harry Reid International Airport, overran and struck the perimeter fence, with no injuries. It said runways 01L and 01R later reopened after inspection.

entries.headline: B737 airborne alert at Virginia Beach
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a B737 aircraft at Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States. The callsign was shown as CNV4989.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an E-6 aircraft at Suisun, California, United States. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Ballina
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Ballina, Ireland. The callsign was shown as PK191.

entries.headline: Tu-160M modernization report highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that Russia revamped the Tu-160M Blackjack bomber with modular electronics.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Kalghatgi
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Kalghatgi, India. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an ON Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Kalghatgi
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Kalghatgi, India. The callsign was shown as NA.
